description:
£135 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this three-bedroom student flat, ideally located close to Jesmond Metro Station, providing convenient access to both Newcastle and Northumbria Universities, as well as Newcastle-s Business, Medical and Dental Schools.

The property comprises a separate living room, a galley-style kitchen equipped with essential white goods, including a washing machine, oven, hob and fridge freezer, and three generously sized double bedrooms. A modern, fully tiled shower room completes the interior, while the property also benefits from a private decked rear yard and off-road parking.

Ideally suited to students looking for comfortable accommodation in a convenient location, this property is well worth viewing.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
